method: Re-checked against the official PDF with pdftotext -layout, -raw and -table, the marking scheme, and page renders/crops of the source pages for every recovered figure.

checks.reason: The paper prints '(I) Calculate that the angular magnification of the microscope.' but the stored (text-corrected) item silently drops 'that', so it does not reproduce the printed wording exactly.

The stored official answer contains the unreadable text-layer debris 'I  6  6 A  0.02 A / 50 150 100 300' instead of the marking scheme's printed I = 6/(50+150+100) = 6/300 A = 0.02 A, so the answer does not reproduce the scheme.

The stored official answer contains the garbled fragment 'Va Vb l 10 / 2 / 30 10 V 10 V / 15 2' instead of the marking scheme's printed Va - Vb = (I/2) x 10 = 30/(15x2) x 10 V = 10 V, so the answer does not reproduce the scheme.

The stored answer moves the denominator 20 to the end ('U=(9x10⁹x10⁻⁶x3x10⁻⁶ + 0 +3 x 10⁻⁶ x 40x20) J / 20'), whereas the scheme prints 20 under the first term only (Kq1q2/r12), and the question text also changes the printed 'Than for which' to 'Then for which'.
